reuse.why: Fintegra reuses linkBankSyncAccount, findOrCreateBank and the import pipeline, while clearAccountLink shares local unlinking between replacement and ordinary unlinking.

duplication.why: fintegraAccounts duplicates the existing account-listing workflow, and downloadFintegraTransactions duplicates Akahu's transaction downloader.

placement.why: Linking policies remain in the shared account-linking orchestrator, downloads remain in sync.ts, and provider configuration and types follow existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the requested linking policies, replacement support and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Centralized linking checks and shared unlink cleanup make future policy changes straightforward, although the copied provider request workflows add maintenance overhead.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Fintegra uses linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank, and replacement shares clearAccountLink with unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: fintegraAccounts and downloadFintegraTransactions reproduce existing workflows under Fintegra-specific function names, server constants and logging.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and a flag-dependent duplicate-link refusal; this requested variation remains centralized and no provider bypasses it.
